name: hashicorp-deck
description: HashiCorp-branded presentation skills. `hashicorp-deck-html` emits a self-contained .html scroll deck: monochrome foundation with sparing product-gradient accents, mono structural labels, scroll-reveal animation, side nav dots and keyboard paging. `hashicorp-deck-htmltopptx` converts an HTML deck into an editable .pptx re-typeset on the official HashiCorp CY26 presentation kit, light or dark, with the two sharing one layout grammar so a deck can be rebuilt in either. Both carry their design system as authoritative tokens so decks built in different repos stay consistent.
